item.title: Girls, 6 and 15, seriously injured in hit-and-run on South Side
item.description: Two pedestrians, a 6-year-old female and a 15-year-old female, were struck by a white SUV in a crosswalk, resulting in the 6-year-old being taken to Comer Children's Hospital in critical condition and the 15-year-old in serious condition, while the offending vehicle fled the scene.

item.title: Suspect sought in Logan Square sexual assault case
item.description: Chicago police are searching for a man in connection with a sexual assault that happened in Logan Square.

item.title: Mount Greenwood family honors legacy of daughter lost to pediatric cancer through St. Baldrick’s
item.description: MOUNT GREENWOOD, Ill. — Each year around St. Patrick's Day, a group of supporters known as “shave-ees” ditch their locks to raise awareness and funds for kids' cancer research. It's called St. Baldrick’s, which is a combination of "St. Patrick's" and "bald," as oftentimes, the rigors of cancer-fighting treatments lead to patients losing their hair. [...]

item.title: Driver runs away from scene after deadly collision on Northwest Side
item.description: A passenger was killed and the driver of a Prius was critically injured in a crash on the Northwest Side of Chicago on Friday morning when a Toyota RAV4 disregarded a traffic signal and struck the Prius.

item.title: Gov. Pritzker seeks $8.6 billion tariff refund after court ruling
item.description: Gov. JB Pritzker has sent a letter and invoice to President Donald Trump, demanding a refund of $8.6 billion in tariffs imposed on Mexican, Canadian and Chinese imports, after the Supreme Court ruled against the tariffs.

item.title: Misty McMichael charged with domestic battery in Will County
item.description: Misty McMichael, the widow of Chicago Bears' Steve McMichael, was arrested and charged with domestic battery after an argument with a man that allegedly became physical.

item.title: Multiple restaurants on Far Northwest Side targeted in overnight ATM thefts
item.description: Chicago police are investigating a series of overnight restaurant burglaries on the Far Northwest Side.

item.title: 17-year-old charged in deadly carjacking spree in Chicago
item.description: A teen is facing a slew of charges in connection with two deadly carjackings and other crimes investigators learned unfolded during an hours-long spree earlier this month.

item.title: Suburban toy company wins legal battle against Trump Administration's tariffs
item.description: Importers around the country have a Vernon Hills toy company to thank for bringing forward the reciprocal tariffs case.
